newsitem.title: USA: Search for missing extends to Colorado.
newsitem.headline: Search for missing extends to Colorado.

text.p: The search for an Air Force A-10 Thunderbolt plane that disappeared three days ago in Arizona was extended to Colorado Saturday, a spokesman at the Davis-Monthan Air Force Base said.
The search was also continuing in Arizona, an Air Force spokesman said.
The plane, piloted by Capt. Craig David Button disappeared Wednesday west of Phoenix, Arizona, while on a training mission in a flight of three A-10s.
When the aircraft was last seen by another member of the flight it did not show any signs of distress, but about one minute later it failed to respond to a radio call from the lead aircraft.
The Air Force immediately began a search for the plane and pilot. Officials said it was possible the pilot made an emergency landing on a remote road.
